purpose: Rank Parent Atlas workstation gates without treating historical percentages or fixture proofs as production authority.

statusModel.wired: A production path calls the owner.
statusModel.proven: Focused, live, replay, or readback evidence passes.
statusModel.done: Wired and proven at the stated scope with acceptance recorded.

scoring.method: Analytic planning score, not an OpenSpec completion claim.
scoring.rule: A lane cannot be DONE when currentness or promotion evidence is missing.

gates.implementation: Make snapshot capture/readback immutable and fail closed when the worktree changes.
gates.blocker: A changing worktree invalidates the source digest; canonical promotion needs a fresh bound snapshot.
gates.next: Re-read the sealed manifest and compare count, source-set checksum, and worktree state in one repeatable-read audit.

gates.implementation: Resolve the two equivalent terminal executions without choosing by timestamp, UUID, or row order.
gates.blocker: Two executions have one equivalent immutable signature; canonicalAuthority remains false.
gates.next: Obtain an explicit owner decision or a new snapshot-native execution receipt.

gates.implementation: Produce and read back canonical whole-source packet identity while keeping source and chunk hash grains separate.
gates.blocker: 0 canonical digest matches; 7,902 packet references are missing and 13,324 mismatch.
gates.next: After owner resolution, run the bounded bridge against exact execution membership and classify every miss.

gates.implementation: Close source -> packet -> atlas_packet_chunk_lineage -> codebase_chunk_index for the selected revision.
gates.blocker: Only 627 packet-lineage matches exist for 24,456 current source bindings.
gates.next: Start with 1 -> 5 -> 52 -> 500 exact members after the digest bridge passes.

gates.implementation: Reconcile stable symbols, versions, tree nodes, and exact source revisions for the closed lineage cohort.
gates.blocker: Bounded AST/ordinal evidence exists, but the current packet/source cohort is not admitted.
gates.next: Run no-create symbol resolution over the first exact lineage cohort.

gates.implementation: Build revision-qualified graph edges and GraphOrdinalMapV1 from the admitted symbol/packet cohort.
gates.blocker: Current graph readiness reports 16 observations and 0 revision-qualified edges.
gates.next: Generate a read-only edge artifact from the exact current cohort; do not reuse stale projections.

gates.implementation: Admit only semantic_768 rows matching packet identity, source revision, workspace revision, and one representation revision.
gates.blocker: 5,730 duplicate canonical IDs and 109,746 missing source revisions, with mixed workspace/representation revisions.
gates.next: Reconcile against the closed source/packet/chunk cohort; never synthesize revisions.

gates.implementation: Produce revision-qualified domain, topic, entity, POS, concept, and ontology tuple observations for admitted packets.
gates.blocker: Classifier/NLP machinery exists, but current packet/source authority and promotion joins remain open.
gates.next: Run bounded schema-validated observations after semantic admission; preserve null lineage as unavailable.

gates.implementation: Assemble lexical, AST, semantic, graph, NLP, and residency signals into CandidateFeatureSnapshotV1 and ContextManifestV2.
gates.blocker: Current ordinal and semantic corpus are not admitted; BitFrost remains derived residency.
gates.next: Replay on the first exact current cohort with availability masks instead of zero-filling unavailable evidence.

gates.implementation: Capture revision-qualified candidate rows, explicit labels, frozen Arrow/mmap corpus, and held-out evaluation.
gates.blocker: No admitted current corpus or human label evidence; runtime promotion is not proven.
gates.next: Capture candidates only after source/packet/semantic admission; keep scores shadow-only.

gates.implementation: Replace regex fixers with machine-JSONL evidence, ACE context, FileMutationPlanV1, approval, CAS, validation, and receipts.
gates.blocker: Streaming capture/tests exist, but live checker protocol, current lineage, and governed replay remain open.
gates.next: Prove machine-verbose capture, then run one isolated FAIL_BEFORE -> PASS_AFTER fixture replay.

gates.implementation: Persist caller-owned WorkflowActionEventV1 identity/checksum and read it back with the runtime receipt.
gates.blocker: Focused tests pass, but live workflow_events contains 0 canonical payloads and no paired canonical outbox payload.
gates.next: Run an explicitly authorized disposable transaction fixture; do not use a production repair replay.

gates.implementation: Run bounded CPU/PyTorch/cuTile parity over an admitted ordinal map with BitFrost budget and eviction controls.
gates.blocker: Live WSL2/RAPIDS/cuVS and same-corpus packet execution outcomes are not proven.
gates.next: Wait for admitted feature/semantic cohort; then prove ceiling, pinned staging, eviction, and parity.

gates.implementation: Refresh revision-qualified progress and daily Graphify deltas from receipts, TaskCandidates, and Kanban projections.
gates.blocker: Receipts exist, but current authority is false and progress must not promote blocked lanes.
gates.next: Keep the derived board updated after each gate; expose authoritative=false and blocker IDs.

layerMapping.L10_agent: governed replay and durable readback open

explicitlyDeferred: semantic duplicate repair or synthetic revisions
